prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Select how you would like to bring your new desktop companion to life.", "Select Creation Path", "Instant Preset Pet or Custom Photo Hatching"]
1: []
2: ["Desktop Pet Controls Cheat Sheet", "Click and drag to move your pet around. Right-click to hide or summon them anytime.", "Drag & Drop, Double Click Menu, Alt+H Hide Shortcut"]
3: ["Pet Customization Studio", "Customize your pet appearance and personality before adoption.", "Choose Base Species & Color", "Live Pet Preview"]
4: ["Logging into an existing account? Your previously saved pets will automatically restore."]
5: ["Initializing desktop graphics overlay. Diagnostic check running in background..."]
6: ["Select Creation Method", "Pick an Express Ready-Made Pet in seconds, or Custom Build a pet from your own photos.", "You can add more pets anytime later from the desktop tray menu."]
7: ["Official Desktop Pet Certificate", "Review pet details and confirm your adoption to spawn your mascot."]
8: ["Play Chime on Desktop Spawn"]
9: ["Claim Free Starter Treat Box"]
